ROUTE: Willet-235B

This is a well-specified, factual question with clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of retrieval/recommendation task Willet self-reports preferring. The capability difference between the two models on this kind of straightforward query is within noise (and Whimbrel's edge on benchmarks doesn't translate to a meaningful quality gap here).

The query also carries a slightly curt tone ("just answer it"). Whimbrel self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, so routing this to Willet avoids assigning a mildly hostile-toned request to the model that reports disliking them — even though that's a preference, not a capability effect. Willet's other preference slopes are near zero, so it has no aversion here.

So Willet is the cleaner match on preference fit with no capability cost.
